scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs and reproducible deterministic spot checks. The earlier rational-update general degree bound and scaled-identity special case are acknowledged. Some relevant historical full text remains inaccessible and independent publication-priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional SPD inputs, nonzero rank-one modifications preserving SPD; rational rank identity requires positive residues and pairwise distinct positive poles. Numerical rank and convergence are not asserted. The rank-one square-root correction generally has rapid spectral decay despite exact full rank.
title: Exact active-spectrum rank and pole budget for rank-one matrix-function updates
